metadata.image-alt: An illustrated TTRPG setting depicting a vibrant, detailed blue market building with bustling activity, stairs, lanterns, and annotated notes for game design.
metadata.image-description: This illustration presents an intricately detailed scene intended as a tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) opening scenario. The central feature is a vivid, blue-painted market building bustling with activity, featuring multiple floors and outdoor staircases connecting levels. Warm lantern lights illuminate various market stalls and interior spaces, creating an inviting and immersive atmosphere. Figures interact in small groups around crates and tables, suggesting active engagement and layered storytelling opportunities. Surrounding the image are handwritten annotations and design notes, hinting at hidden secrets, puzzles, and narrative possibilities integral to immersive gameplay. This richly illustrated environment enhances player engagement and narrative depth, perfect for detailed exploration in a TTRPG session.

coverImageAlt: Modular cyan and slate tabletop terrain with branching paths, a tower, cave, portal, and orange keystone.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: modular tabletop terrain pieces for hooks, locations, factions, mysteries, and escalating encounters lock together into one playable adventure structure
Scene/backdrop: warm paper tabletop fading into a deep navy room with uncluttered negative space
Subject: one compact raised terrain assembly built from distinct cyan and slate tiles—a threshold, branching path, tower, hidden chamber, and open wilderness—joined around a sparing orange keystone
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with carved paperboard terrain, wood miniatures, and dimensional model-making detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; high three-quarter tabletop view; single cohesive terrain silhouette; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: inventive, adventurous, structured, restrained atmospheric backlighting
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: cut paperboard, carved wood, linen map surface, translucent vellum mist
Constraints: every tile and surface blank with no runes, symbols, grids, or writing; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: recognizable game brands, dice faces, character sheets, generic dungeon map grids, screens, crowded battle scenes, clutter
